plane-earth.name: Earth (Human World)
plane-earth.description: Modern civilization, national capitals, and hunter guilds defending against gate breaks.

plane-jeju.name: Jeju Island Exclusion Zone
plane-jeju.description: Overrun island province completely quarantined after catastrophic gate failures.

plane-demon-castle.name: Demon Castle Dimension
plane-demon-castle.description: 100-floor trial tower created by the Architect containing ingredients for the Holy Water of Life.

loc-seoul-assoc.name: Seoul Hunters Association HQ
loc-seoul-assoc.description: Central command tower overseeing South Korea’s gate alerts and Hunter evaluations.

loc-double-dungeon.name: Cartenon Temple (Double Dungeon)
loc-double-dungeon.description: Subterranean sanctuary of God Statues where Sung Jin-woo received the System re-awakening.

loc-ahjin-office.name: Ahjin Guild Headquarters
loc-ahjin-office.description: Streamlined guild headquarters managed by Yoo Jin-ho solely supporting Sung Jin-woo’s solo raids.

loc-hunters-guild-hq.name: Hunters Guild Sky Tower
loc-hunters-guild-hq.description: High-rise skyscraper complex hosting Korea’s premier raid teams led by Choi Jong-in and Cha Hae-in.

loc-white-tiger-gym.name: White Tiger Martial Dojo
loc-white-tiger-gym.description: Elite combat training center for Baek Yoon-ho’s frontline melee strikers.

loc-red-gate-forest.name: Red Gate Sub-Zero Forest
loc-red-gate-forest.description: Quarantined dimension filled with deadly blizzards, Ice Bears, and White Walkers.

loc-scavenger-hq.name: Scavenger Guild Citadel (New York)
loc-scavenger-hq.description: Massive American headquarters housing National Level Hunter Thomas Andre’s elite force.

loc-draw-sword-hq.name: Draw Sword Guild Fortress (Tokyo)
loc-draw-sword-hq.description: Seat of power for Goto Ryuji’s 21 S-Rank Japanese hunters.

loc-jeju-coastline.name: Jeju Shoreline Landing Zone
loc-jeju-coastline.description: Amphibious invasion staging area for the combined Korea-Japan Joint S-Rank raid.

loc-ant-queen-nest.name: Ant Queen’s Underground Hatchery
loc-ant-queen-nest.description: Bioluminescent hive subterranean network where the mutant Ant King was born.

loc-jeju-observatory.name: Mt. Halla Peak Observatory
loc-jeju-observatory.description: Highest volcanic peak on Jeju Island where Jin-woo arrived via Shadow Exchange.

loc-demon-f1.name: Demon Castle Gates (Floor 1)
loc-demon-f1.description: Entry gate to the 100-floor dimensional trial leading to the Elixir of Life ingredients.

loc-demon-f50.name: Vulcan’s Scorched Forge (Floor 50)
loc-demon-f50.description: Lava-submerged fortress guarded by the colossal club-wielding Demon Vulcan.

loc-demon-f75.name: Metus’s Necromantic Spire (Floor 75)
loc-demon-f75.description: Haunted cemetery tower defended by Arch-lich Metus and legions of undead.

loc-demon-f100.name: Monarch Baran’s Sky Palace (Floor 100)
loc-demon-f100.description: Throne room in the clouds where Monarch of White Flames Baran commands lightning wyverns.

faction-ahjin.name: Ahjin Guild
faction-ahjin.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

faction-hunters-assoc.name: Korean Hunters Association
faction-hunters-assoc.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

faction-hunters-guild.name: Hunters Guild
faction-hunters-guild.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

faction-white-tiger.name: White Tiger Guild
faction-white-tiger.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

faction-scavenger.name: Scavenger Guild (USA)
faction-scavenger.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

faction-draw-sword.name: Draw Sword Guild (Japan)
faction-draw-sword.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

faction-monarchs.name: The Sovereign Monarchs
faction-monarchs.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

faction-rulers.name: The Rulers of Light
faction-rulers.description: Leading guild or primordial faction operating in the Hunter universe.

arc-double-dungeon.name: Double Dungeon Incident
arc-double-dungeon.description: Jin-woo survives Cartenon Temple and is chosen by the System.

arc-reawakening.name: Re-Awakening & Solo Raids
arc-reawakening.description: Jin-woo tests his daily leveling quests and clears low-rank dungeons with Yoo Jin-ho.

arc-job-change.name: Job Change & Blood-Red Igris
arc-job-change.description: Jin-woo conquers the class advancement dungeon and extracts his first shadow knight, Igris.

arc-red-gate.name: Red Gate & High Orcs
arc-red-gate.description: Jin-woo rescues White Tiger recruits inside the Red Gate and clears the High Orc dungeon.

arc-jeju-raid.name: Jeju Island S-Rank Raid
arc-jeju-raid.description: Korea and Japan launch the 4th raid; Jin-woo slays the Ant King and extracts Beru.

arc-conference.name: Ahjin Guild & International Conference
arc-conference.description: Jin-woo establishes Ahjin Guild and clashes with Thomas Andre in Maryland.

arc-monarch-war.name: Monarchs War & Death of Presidents
arc-monarch-war.description: Sovereign Monarchs invade Seoul; Ashborn passes full authority to Jin-woo.

arc-final-battle.name: Final Battle of Destruction & Epilogue
arc-final-battle.description: The Shadow Army faces Antares and the Dragon Legion; the Cup of Reincarnation resets time.

stage-e-d-rank.name: E-Rank & D-Rank Awakened
stage-e-d-rank.description: Entry-level awakened humans capable of dealing with low-tier beasts with standard weapons.

stage-c-b-rank.name: C-Rank & B-Rank Vanguard
stage-c-b-rank.description: Competent strike party members who handle standard city gate defense.

stage-a-rank.name: A-Rank Elite Hunter
stage-a-rank.description: Top 1% guild captains with destructive spellcraft and superhuman physical strength.

stage-s-rank.name: S-Rank National Asset
stage-s-rank.description: Hunters whose mana overflows standard gauges; capable of leveling entire city wards.

stage-national-level.name: National Level Hunter
stage-national-level.description: Superpowers who survived S-Rank gates and wield Ruler’s Telekinesis (Dominator’s Touch).

stage-monarch-vessel.name: Monarch Sovereign Contender
stage-monarch-vessel.description: Avatars of primordial darkness and chaos commanding world-ending elemental armies.

stage-shadow-monarch.name: True Shadow Monarch
stage-shadow-monarch.description: Master of eternal death with infinite shadow extraction and dimensional dominion.

sung-jin-woo.name: Sung Jin-woo
sung-jin-woo.description: World’s Weakest E-Rank Hunter who re-awakened as the Player and inheritor of Ashborn.

cha-hae-in.name: Cha Hae-in
cha-hae-in.description: Korea’s ninth S-Rank hunter and master swordswoman with heightened mana olfactory perception.

choi-jong-in.name: Choi Jong-in
choi-jong-in.description: Master fire mage and Guildmaster of Hunters Guild, renowned for continental flame incantations.

baek-yoon-ho.name: Baek Yoon-ho
baek-yoon-ho.description: Guildmaster of White Tiger Guild possessing divine white tiger transformation ability.

go-gun-hee.name: Go Gun-hee
go-gun-hee.description: President of the Korean Hunters Association and vessel for the Brightest Fragment of Brilliant Light.
aliases: The Sky Above the Sky / Association President

woo-jin-chul.name: Woo Jin-chul
woo-jin-chul.description: Chief of the Surveillance Team who later succeeds Go Gun-hee as Association Chairman.

min-byung-gu.name: Min Byung-gu
min-byung-gu.description: Legendary S-Rank healer who sacrificed his life during the fourth Jeju Island extermination raid.

lim-tae-gyu.name: Lim Tae-gyu
lim-tae-gyu.description: Master archer and S-Rank Guildmaster specialized in long-range mana projectile strikes.

ma-dong-wook.name: Ma Dong-wook
ma-dong-wook.description: Impenetrable shield tank Guildmaster who held the line against the mutant ant swarm on Jeju.

hwang-dong-soo.name: Hwang Dong-soo
hwang-dong-soo.description: Vengeful Korean-American S-Rank hunter whose brother Hwang Dong-suk was slain by Jin-woo.

thomas-andre.name: Thomas Andre
thomas-andre.description: World #1 National Level Hunter, vessel of the Ruler, wields Reinforcement and Black Hole gravity.

liu-zhigang.name: Liu Zhigang
liu-zhigang.description: China’s supreme 7-Star Hunter who obliterated giant ants attempting to cross the Yellow Sea.

christopher-reed.name: Christopher Reed
christopher-reed.description: American National Level Hunter who fell in tragic battle against the Sovereign Monarchs.

goto-ryuji.name: Goto Ryuji
goto-ryuji.description: Japan’s premier swordsman and Guildmaster who sought National Level status before facing the Ant King.

igris.name: Blood-Red Commander Igris
igris.description: First loyal knight extracted in the Job Change quest; wields the Longsword of the Demon King.
aliases: Knight of the Red Robe / Marshal

beru.name: Ant King Beru
beru.description: Mutant Ant King extracted at Jeju Island; devout worshipper of his liege Sung Jin-woo.
aliases: Shadow Marshal / Loyal Ant Swarm Leader

bellion.name: Grand Marshal Bellion
bellion.description: Ashborn’s ancient Grand Marshal who emerged from the colossal Gate above Seoul with dual-bladed wings.

tank.name: Iron-Fanged Tank
tank.description: Alpha Ice Bear extracted inside the Red Gate; frontline armored beast of the Shadow Army.

iron.name: Shield Knight Iron
iron.description: Resurrected shadow of A-Rank shield-bearer Kim Chul; taunts enemies with earth-shaking war cries.

tusk.name: High Shaman Tusk
tusk.description: High Orc Great Shaman Kargalgan extracted in the Hunter Guild A-Rank dungeon, wields the Orb of Avarice.

kaisel.name: Sky Sovereign Kaisel
kaisel.description: Wyvern mount extracted on the 100th floor of the Demon Castle following Baran’s defeat.

antares.name: Antares
antares.description: Leader of the Sovereign Monarchs; incarnation of cosmic chaos wielding Breath of Destruction.
aliases: Monarch of Destruction / King of Dragons

ashborn.name: Ashborn
ashborn.description: Original Shadow Monarch who defected from the Rulers to defend absolute cosmic equilibrium.
aliases: Greatest Fragment of Brilliant Light / Previous Shadow Monarch

baran.name: Demon King Baran
baran.description: Sovereign of White Flames ruler of the Demon Castle 100th floor; summoned thunder and blue lightning.

rakan.name: Beast Monarch Rakan
rakan.description: Cruel Monarch of Fangs who ambushed Go Gun-hee and Sung Jin-woo in Seoul.

sillad.name: Frost Monarch Sillad
sillad.description: Monarch of Frost capable of freezing continental cities in temporal stasis.

sung-il-hwan.name: Sung Il-hwan
sung-il-hwan.description: Trapped in a dungeon for a decade, granted divine Ruler power to protect his son from the Monarchs.

yoo-jin-ho.name: Yoo Jin-ho
yoo-jin-ho.description: Yoojin Construction heir who pledged unyielding loyalty to Jin-woo across 20 dungeon raids.

lee-joo-hee.name: Lee Joo-hee
lee-joo-hee.description: Compassionate B-Rank healer who patched up Jin-woo in the early days before the Cartenon Temple.

sung-jin-ah.name: Sung Jin-ah
sung-jin-ah.description: High school student protected by Jin-woo’s high orc shadows during the Orc Gate break.

ev-double-dungeon.name: Cartenon Temple Bloodbath
ev-double-dungeon.description: The hunter party is massacred by colossal God Statues; Jin-woo is chosen by the System.

ev-awakening.name: Courage of the Weak Awakening
ev-awakening.description: Jin-woo wakes in a hospital bed with a floating quest window visible only to him.

ev-igris-duel.name: Job Change Trial: Blood-Red Igris
ev-igris-duel.description: Jin-woo defeats Blood-Red Commander Igris in hand-to-hand combat and receives the Shadow Lord title.

ev-igris-extracted.name: First Shadow Extraction: Arise
ev-igris-extracted.description: Jin-woo utters "ARISE" to extract Igris and his royal knight shadow army.

ev-red-gate-break.name: Red Gate Ice Domain Conquest
ev-red-gate-break.description: Jin-woo slays the White Walker leader Baruka and extracts Iron and Tank.

ev-re-evaluation.name: Official S-Rank Re-Evaluation
ev-re-evaluation.description: The Association’s mana sensor shatters; Jin-woo is officially registered as Korea’s 10th S-Rank.

ev-baran-slain.name: Monarch Baran Overthrown
ev-baran-slain.description: Jin-woo executes Demon King Baran, claims the Holy Water of Life, and extracts Wyvern Kaisel.

ev-jeju-landing.name: Fourth Jeju Island Raid Commences
ev-jeju-landing.description: Korean and Japanese S-Rank strike teams launch an amphibious raid into the ant hive.

ev-min-sacrifice.name: Min Byung-gu Slain by Ant King
ev-min-sacrifice.description: The mutant Ant King decapitates Goto Ryuji and mortally wounds healer Min Byung-gu.

ev-jinwoo-arrival.name: Shadow Exchange into Halla Crater
ev-jinwoo-arrival.description: Jin-woo teleports directly to Cha Hae-in’s shadow and confronts the Ant King.

ev-beru-extracted.name: Birth of Shadow Marshal Beru
ev-beru-extracted.description: Jin-woo extracts the Ant King, naming him Beru; Beru kneels with tears of absolute loyalty.

ev-ahjin-founded.name: Ahjin Guild Founded
ev-ahjin-founded.description: Jin-woo and Yoo Jin-ho establish Ahjin Guild, bypassing the major corporate conglomerates.

ev-thomas-clash.name: Maryland Showdown: Jin-woo vs Goliath
ev-thomas-clash.description: Thomas Andre intervenes to protect Hwang Dong-soo; Jin-woo dismantles the Goliath with bare fists.

ev-gogunhee-death.name: Assassination of Go Gun-hee
ev-gogunhee-death.description: Beast Monarch Rakan pierces Go Gun-hee’s heart before Jin-woo can arrive.

ev-ashborn-heritage.name: Ashborn Passes the Crown of Death
ev-ashborn-heritage.description: In the territory of eternal rest, Ashborn relinquishes his Black Heart completely to Jin-woo.

ev-bellion-arrival.name: Colossal Gate Opens in Seoul Skies
ev-bellion-arrival.description: Grand Marshal Bellion and hundreds of thousands of ancient shadows arrive to serve their master.

ev-antares-showdown.name: Clash of the Primordial Sovereigns
ev-antares-showdown.description: The Shadow Army and the Destruction Dragon Legion collide in a planetary duel of extinction.

ev-time-reset.name: Cup of Reincarnation Reset
ev-time-reset.description: Jin-woo resets time by 10 years, choosing to fight the Monarchs alone inside the Dimensional Rift.
